basic_profile.bio: I'm a 35-year-old journeyman electrician from Chicago, passionate about skilled trades and continuously upgrading my skills. When I'm not working, I spend my time gaming, particularly enjoying sports games like NBA Live and action-adventures like God of War. I have a soft spot for comfort food, especially mac and cheese, and I love experimenting with new recipes. Typically online during evenings and weekends, I use Reddit for both relaxation and learning more about software engineering, as I'm considering a career switch. Currently single, I find joy in the simple things like a good game, a tasty meal, or a new skill learned.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have over a decade of experience in electrical work, having completed an apprenticeship and earned my journeyman license. My knowledge extends to various aspects of home and industrial wiring, safety protocols, and emerging technologies in the field. I've also been self-teaching programming and software engineering through online courses and community forums.
